rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for saying that something is enough or adequate.

example.english: This information is sufficiently complete for us to make a decision.
example.traditional: 呢啲資料夠我哋做決定喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 zi1 liu2 gau3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 kyut3 ding6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the sufficient degree is expressed as the result or manner of carrying out a verb.

example.english: You explained it sufficiently clearly, so everyone understands.
example.traditional: 你講得夠清楚，大家都明喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 gau3 cing1 co2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 ming4 laa3
